newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Friday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Friday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Friday:

Spokesman Nikolaus van der Pas briefed on the EU-Russia summit on Monday. He said Commission President Jacques Santer, Commissioner Hans van den Broek, Dutch Prime Minister Wim Kok, Dutch Foreign Minister Hans van Mierlo, Russian President Boris Yeltsin and Russian Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin would attend (see BC-EUROPE-RUSSIA). He said there would be an EU news conference at 1500/1200 GMT at the Commission delegation in Moscow.
Spokesman Filippo di Robilant briefed on the measures taken by the Commission following President Santer's speech to the European Parliament on BSE. He said that
- the Commission was waiting to know who its EP institutionnal interlocutor would be,
- the group of Commissioners for health would hold its first meeting in March,
- the inter-service health and consumers group had been reinforced,
- the plan for personnel transfers would be ready on March 10,
- the DGXXIV provisional organigram should be approved by the Commission on Wednesday March 12,
- in the framework of the "fact finding missions", Commissioner Emma Bonino would visit the U.S. Food and Drug Administration at Easter,
- a revision of the green paper on food policy would presented to the Commission before the end of March,
- the new DGXXIV services should be operational by the end of April and
- that the Commission would hold two conferences on food issues before October.
Spokesman Joao Vale de Almeida briefed on the informal Development Council starting on Friday night in Amsterdam. He said there would probably be a news conference on Saturday afternoon in Amsterdam.
Spokesman Peter Jorgensen briefed on Monday and Tuesday's Environment Council.

In answer to a question, di Robilant said that if the British proposal on certified herds came before March 12, it would be dealt with by Commissioner Franz Fischler but if it arrived after that date, it would be Commissioner Bonino's competence.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/97/169: The Commission authorises the acquisition of the joint control of the BBC's home service transmission by an international consortium.
- Speech/97/47: Speech by Commissioner Edith Cresson on the fifth RTD framework programme.
- Speech/97/48: Speech by Commissoner Anita Gradin on the European year against racism and xenophobia.
- Memo/97/21: Calendar for the week of March 3-8, 1997.
- Memo/97/22: EU-Russian relations.
- ME97/28.2: Midday Express.
